iti68:2.1: Yassa kassaci bhikkhave rāgo appahīno doso appahīno moho appahīno,
iti68:2.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bandho mārassa, paṭimukk'assa mārapāso, yathākāmakaraṇīyo ca pāpimato.
iti68:2.3: Yassa kassaci bhikkhave rāgo pahīno doso pahīno moho pahīno,
iti68:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave abandho mārassa, omukk'assa mārapāso, na-yathākāmakaraṇīyo ca pāpimato ti.
iti68:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||9|| 69. (Tik.
